accelerator_bound.arm_mix_note: 0.52 = one Solver contact in lock-row equivalents, solver / (perception + solver) node seconds of scripts/flights/nx/l338_cost_inputs.json; a direct-only contact carries no knowledge, so the prefill side is an over-estimate and the reasoning length is not; the smoke measures the real mix
accelerator_bound.caps_note: generation = rows x (1 contact + 1 answer-only fallback), FIT = rows x 1 x 1 counting endpoint (core.preparation_fit.direct_only_fit_contact_cap, the value build_direct_only_raw_fit_gate demands), audio = ceil(roster speech-seconds x the generation contacts per row). failure_policy: Stop and preserve on the first failure. No automatic restart, replay, row filtering, roster, prompt, geometry or cap change. AT MOST ONE root-diagnosed recovery re-registration per run id (a new generation attempt id AND a new live_phase_fit run and attempt id); a second failure closes the cell and the fix is proven on a four-row dry run. A response whose delivered content carries a reasoning marker is a failure of the read, not of a row: it stops the flight (reasoning_content_guard). A partial manifest is never scored and never read.

read_rule.claim_boundary: No system-level, superiority, generalisation, test or confirmatory claim; a development-fold capability read of the bare core.

read_rule.primary: official SLURP pooled SLU-F1 (micro; scorer slurp-slu-official-train, the pinned official evaluate.py), natural-mixture weighting, with intent accuracy (scenario_action_exact) beside it; the per-row F1 is a repo diagnostic reported beside the pooled F1, never an official SLURP number

replicates.note: lock is the delivering pass; aa and ab are request-identical replicates in the same chain (noise model M1: separate runs, not the in-flight twin, because the direct-only program has no arm table). Same-chain replicates also absorb session drift, so they measure at least the within-run decoding term.

read_rule.truncation: A cap-hit row is sealed as a receipted empty answer (saea-empty-completion-v1 and saea-thinking-answer-fallback-v1) and scored as such; never re-asked beyond the one registered answer-only fallback (266-E preregistration section 3; decision 199). The M4 trace logs the truncation flag per contact.
read_rule.twin_admissibility: |SLU-F1(aa) - SLU-F1(lock)| <= 1.2 pp (the port analysis recipe's twin rule)
